preconditions.expression: all(t.isdigit() and 1 <= int(t) <= 1000 for t in stdin.splitlines()[0].split())
preconditions.description: The first line contains a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(x.isdigit() and 1 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each subsequent line contains a single integer x (1 ≤ x ≤ 10^18) representing the number of cells for building staircases.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines() == [str(count_nice_staircases(x)) for x in [int(x) for x in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]]
postconditions.description: For each test case x, output the maximal number of different nice staircases that can be built using no more than x cells in total. A nice staircase with n stairs has exactly n(n+1)/2 cells and can be covered by n disjoint squares.
